name: Spell Script Target
description: Defines the valid targets for spells with script targeting (implicit targets like TARGET_UNIT_SCRIPT_NEAR_CASTER, TARGET_GAMEOBJECT_SCRIPT_NEAR_CASTER or persistent area auras). When such a spell is cast, only the creatures/gameobjects listed here are selected as targets.

fields.name: Target Entry
fields.help: Meaning depends on Type: gameobject or creature template entry (0 with type gameobject = any gameobject), a spawn guid for the obsolete guid types, or a string_id.Id for the string id type.

fields.name: Inverse Effect Mask
fields.help: Mask of spell effect indexes for which this entry is NOT used.
